summary: Add observational provider quota and durable credit evidence for account-limit displays and CAM-R01/CAM-R02 SLOs without changing harness scheduling or enforcement.

replay.detail: The new replicated durable usage.limits.observed kind is retained independently of local writer configuration. Older members quarantine the unknown non-authority kind for replay after upgrade. Quota and credit evidence is projected per producer; configured writers are selected at read time. For each durable credit, terminal states are absorbing across hosts: redeemed wins over forfeited, and forfeited wins over available or unknown regardless of timestamp. Redeemed is positive evidence; forfeiture is inferred. Within a state class the newest measured_at wins, with claim ID breaking ties.

schema.detail: The account-limit projection upgrades from version 2 to 3 and rebuilds from durable claims. A rebuildable latest-credit projection avoids replaying durable credit history on each SLO read.

rules.detail: retention.toml declares usage.limits.observed durable with no checkpoint pruning rule; producer evidence remains available for configuration changes and projection rebuilds.

compatibility.detail: The optional [usage_limits] daemon configuration section accepts a writers list. Empty or absent writers deny local producer appends and show no producer evidence, while schema-valid replication remains accepted. The producer must write as its configured agent identity. Observational evidence adds provider account digests and account references, per-window coverage and origin host, and durable credit identity, expiry, state and disposition metadata. Harness scheduling and enforcement continue to use harness-only evidence. During credit catch-up SLOs use the existing no-data status with catching-up and cursor progress in open current/explain strings; the closed client-v0 status enum is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No coordinated fleet restart or capability gate is required. Durable credit history has no finite retention bound, so first-open credit replay is deferred rather than blocking startup. Configured reads start resumable catch-up batches of at most 64 claim rows with a persisted cursor and release the writer lock between batches. Until complete, credit reads expose catching-up progress and SLOs cannot report success. Empty configuration with no projection skips initialization until a read or configuration change requires it.

manual.detail: Configure [usage_limits] writers with explicitly authorized producer agent identities to enable local publication and observational displays; restart the daemon after changing configuration.

recovery.detail: Before rolling back to an older binary with strict configuration parsers, remove the [usage_limits] section. Backup restore retains every schema-valid durable observation regardless of current writer configuration. After restore or an interrupted upgrade, derived credit catch-up resumes from its persisted cursor; quota and credit projections can be rebuilt from retained claims after upgrading again. Restored evidence remains excluded from observational folds until its writer is configured.
